name: article_id
label: Article ID
help: A finished article: the Content ID from Search content, or the Article ID from Write an article.

name: channel_id
label: Blog
help: A connected blog. Only blogs that are connected and working are listed.

name: as_draft
label: Send as a draft
help: Sends the article to the blog now as a draft, to review and publish there.

name: at
label: Publish at
help: When to publish the article if it is not sent as a draft. Left empty, it is published in about five minutes.

name: original_url
label: Original URL
help: The address where the article was first published. Every copy credits it as the original.
